string.text: The anarchists of the Zone who profess the belief that the Zone is a sanctuary of freedom, where all the laws, rules, and conventions of the outside world cease to apply. Their motto is: "Do as you please, but don't interfere with others." Because of these beliefs, they are in conflict with the "Duty" faction and government forces. They primarily use weapons manufactured by NATO countries.

A militarized faction of stalkers that considers it their duty to halt the expansion of the Zone. They actively engage in the destruction of mutants and artifacts, and also attempt to impose their own order within the Zone, which has led to conflict with the "Freedom" faction. They are usually equipped with weaponry from former Soviet-bloc countries.
